definitions.explanation: The activity of staying outdoors in a tent.
A temporary residence for sports training or other organized activities.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{山|やま}でキャンプをした。
examples.english: I went camping in the mountains over the weekend.
examples.notes: キャンプをする = to go camping

examples.japanese: {野球|やきゅう}チームは{春|はる}のキャンプを{沖縄|おきなわ}で{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: The baseball team holds spring training camp in Okinawa.

examples.japanese: キャンプ{場|じょう}の{予約|よやく}が{取|と}れた。
examples.english: I was able to get a reservation at the campsite.

notes:
USAGE: キャンプ refers both to recreational camping and sports training camps. Japan has a strong camping culture with well-maintained campgrounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・キャンプをする/{行|い}く (to go camping)
・キャンプ{場|じょう} (campsite, campground)
・キャンプファイヤー (campfire)
・キャンプ{用品|ようひん} (camping gear)
・{夏|なつ}キャンプ (summer camp)
・デイキャンプ (day camping)

RELATED:
・グランピング (glamping - glamorous camping)
